/.title: IntoSTL — Free STL & 3D Printing Tools
/.description: Free browser-based tools for converting images and 3D files to STL or 3MF. No sign-up and no uploads — your files stay on your device.

/image-to-stl/.title: Image to STL Converter — Free Online Tool | IntoSTL
/image-to-stl/.description: Convert JPG or PNG images into printable STL models in your browser. Create relief or extruded models for free, with no upload or sign-up.

/png-to-stl/.title: PNG to STL Converter — Free Online Tool | IntoSTL
/png-to-stl/.description: Convert PNG images into printable STL models in your browser. Transparent PNGs can be extruded, while opaque images can become reliefs.

/3mf-to-stl/.title: 3MF to STL Converter — Free, No Upload | IntoSTL
/3mf-to-stl/.description: Convert 3MF files to STL directly in your browser while preserving final geometry and transforms. Free, private and no upload required.

/logo-to-stl/.title: Logo to STL Converter — Create Printable 3D Logos | IntoSTL
/logo-to-stl/.description: Turn PNG or JPG logos into extruded STL models for 3D printing. Works best with transparent or high-contrast logos and runs locally in your browser.

/jpg-to-stl/.title: JPG to STL Converter — Free Online Tool | IntoSTL
/jpg-to-stl/.description: Convert JPG or JPEG images into printable STL relief models directly in your browser. Free, private and no sign-up required.

/stl-to-3mf/.title: STL to 3MF Converter — Free, No Upload | IntoSTL
/stl-to-3mf/.description: Convert binary or ASCII STL files to 3MF directly in your browser. Geometry is preserved and STL units are treated as millimeters.
